questions.scenario: You need to get rid of your old 9th standard textbooks. What is your strategy to get the best value?

options.text: Physically carry them to the local 'raddi-wala' or wholesale market and aggressively negotiate for the best cash price.
Calculate the exact 60% depreciation value of the books to know your absolute minimum selling price before talking to anyone.
Clean the books, arrange them nicely, and take aesthetic, well-lit pictures to post on OLX or student WhatsApp groups.
Find a junior who desperately needs them and convince them it's a 'premium package deal' that includes your handwritten notes.

questions.scenario: You are watching 'Shark Tank India' with your family. Which part of the pitch excites you the most?

options.text: Hearing the struggle story of how the founder started in a tiny garage and did all the local scooty deliveries themselves.
Immediately calculating the company's total valuation in your head the second they ask for '1 Crore for 5% equity'.
Judging the startup's packaging and mentally redesigning their ugly logo into something modern and cool.
Watching how the founders cleverly dodge the Sharks' tough questions and negotiate a multiple-shark deal.

questions.scenario: Your friend group is setting up a Game Stall at the society's Diwali Mela. What is your main job?

options.text: Running around the crowded wholesale market (like Sadar Bazaar) to buy cheap prizes and physically setting up the tent.
Tracking exactly how many Rs. 20 tickets need to be sold to break even on the Rs. 500 stall rent we paid.
Making a massive, colorful, eye-catching chart paper poster that draws all the kids in the society to your stall.
Assigning shifts to friends so no one gets tired, and standing in the front to loudly invite uncle-aunties to play.

questions.scenario: You desperately need an extra Rs. 2000 for a trip or a new video game. How do you get it?

options.text: Offering to wash the neighbors' cars or walk their dogs for a month using pure physical hard work.
Showing Papa an Excel sheet of your savings and proposing a 'loan' with a strict pocket-money repayment plan.
Using Canva to design customized digital birthday invitations for your mom's kitty party friends and charging a premium.
Pitching a solid 'investment' proposal to Mummy, promising to manage all household chores if she funds you upfront.

questions.scenario: Your school is hosting a massive inter-school fest, and your team is in charge of the food counter.

options.text: Making 5 trips to the local bakery on your cycle to ensure the patties and pastries are always restocked.
Monitoring the cash box like a hawk and ensuring nobody gets a free samosa without a valid printed coupon.
Arranging the food beautifully on the counter and creating a catchy menu board with cool names for the dishes.
Dealing with the angry teacher who complains about the crowd, while keeping your team motivated under pressure.

questions.scenario: You find a major problem in your society: the stray dogs keep tearing the garbage bags at night.

options.text: Personally finding some scrap wood and building a heavy makeshift lid to cover the society's main dustbin.
Calculating how much each flat needs to contribute (just Rs. 15!) to collectively buy a heavy-duty metal bin.
Designing a cute WhatsApp forward with pictures of the dogs, urging the society to adopt a cleaner disposal method.
Calling a quick meeting of your friends in the park to divide the society into 'blocks' and collect funds door-to-door.

questions.scenario: During a group project, someone drops the thermocol model and it breaks right before the teacher arrives.

options.text: Sprinting to the nearby stationery shop, buying Fevikwik, and frantically putting it back together in 2 minutes.
Quickly assessing which parts are completely destroyed and calculating if you have enough pocket money to replace them.
Covering the broken part with some leftover chart paper and smartly convincing the teacher it's a 'cross-sectional view'.
Calming the panicking group down, assigning two people to fix it, while you distract the teacher with an intro speech.

questions.scenario: You want to start a YouTube or Instagram page with your friends. What's your main focus?

options.text: Actually filming the videos on your phone, editing them late at night, and commenting on big pages for reach.
Obsessively checking the YouTube Studio analytics, watch time, and figuring out the exact algorithm for monetization.
Deciding the exact aesthetic of the page, designing a killer profile picture, and picking the trending audio.
Reaching out to other pages for collaborations and making sure your friends upload on a strict schedule.

questions.scenario: You are organizing a surprise birthday party for your best friend. What is your role?

options.text: Sneaking out to pick up the cake, bringing the cold drinks, and personally blowing up 50 balloons.
Collecting exactly Rs. 150 from 10 friends and strictly making sure the party stays within the Rs. 1500 budget.
Curating the perfect Spotify playlist and ensuring the lighting in the room looks amazing for Instagram pictures.
Making sure the friend's parents are distracted and giving the final signal for everyone to jump out and yell 'Surprise!'

questions.scenario: What is your absolute favorite type of 'Jugaad' (Indian life-hack)?

options.text: Fixing a broken chappal strap with a safety pin so you can keep running without having to buy a new one.
Finding hidden promo codes on Swiggy/Zomato and splitting the bill so perfectly that you basically eat for free.
Upcycling an old Bournvita plastic jar by hand-painting it into a beautiful, aesthetic pen stand for your study table.
Convincing the class monitor to wipe your name off the 'talkative students' list in exchange for helping them with homework.

Hustler_Founder.title: The Ground-Level Hustler (Bootstrapper / Execution Expert)
Hustler_Founder.primary_match_text: You are relentless, action-oriented, and the king/queen of 'Jugaad'. You don't wait for things to be perfect; you just start executing. You believe in hard work over fancy presentations.
Hustler_Founder.day_in_the_life: Visiting wholesale markets, packing customer orders at 2 AM, handling deliveries yourself, and solving on-the-ground emergencies to keep the startup alive.
Hustler_Founder.alternative_match_text: If not a startup founder, your execution skills make you a perfect fit for an Operations Manager, Supply Chain Head, or Event Manager.
Hustler_Founder.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any stream (Commerce or Science preferred). Degree: BBA, B.Com, or B.Tech. Next Steps: Focus less on textbook theory and more on doing real-world internships or starting a small campus side-hustle.

Finance_Founder.title: The Numbers Ninja (Finance & Analytics Founder)
Finance_Founder.primary_match_text: You are highly logical and love metrics. You understand that a business isn't just about a cool idea, it's about profit margins, cash flow, and making the math work.
Finance_Founder.day_in_the_life: Creating massive Excel financial models, calculating Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), optimizing pricing strategies, and ensuring the company doesn't run out of money.
Finance_Founder.alternative_match_text: Your love for numbers and logic would also make you an incredible Investment Banker, Chartered Accountant (CA), or Data Scientist.
Finance_Founder.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Commerce with Math or Science (PCM). Degree: B.Com (Hons), Economics, or B.Tech. Next Steps: Pursue professional certifications like CA, CFA, or an MBA in Finance.

Visionary_Founder.title: The Creative Visionary (Product & Brand Founder)
Visionary_Founder.primary_match_text: You have an amazing aesthetic sense and understand human psychology. You know that people buy with their eyes first. You are the creative brain that makes a product look and feel premium.
Visionary_Founder.day_in_the_life: Designing the app's user interface, creating beautiful investor pitch decks, directing marketing ad campaigns, and obsessing over the exact color of the logo.
Visionary_Founder.alternative_match_text: With your creativity, you would also excel as a Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), UI/UX Designer, or Creative Director.
Visionary_Founder.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any stream (Arts, Commerce, or Science). Degree: Bachelor of Design (B.Des), Mass Communication, or BBA in Marketing. Next Steps: Build a strong digital portfolio on Behance or Dribbble.

CEO_Team_Builder.title: The Mastermind CEO (Leader & Team Builder)
CEO_Team_Builder.primary_match_text: You are a natural leader, negotiator, and storyteller. You might not code the app or do the math, but you know how to bring the best coders and mathematicians together to build an empire.
CEO_Team_Builder.day_in_the_life: Pitching the startup vision to big investors for funding, interviewing and hiring top talent, resolving fights between co-founders, and setting the grand strategy.
CEO_Team_Builder.alternative_match_text: Your leadership and people skills would make you a fantastic Corporate Strategy Manager, HR Director, or Public Relations (PR) Head.
CEO_Team_Builder.educational_roadmap: 11th/12th: Any stream (Commerce or Science preferred). Degree: BBA, Economics, or B.Tech. Next Steps: Crack CAT and get a top-tier MBA from an IIM or ISB to build a massive professional network.
